verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a one-time company incorporation and formation service covering entity formation, EIN, 83(b) filings, banking setup and SAFEs. It has no user-built automations, so versioning, reviewing, or rolling them back is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Atlas shipping any automation feature that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
